Meta.title: Verba — Practice writing in English

Hero.subtitle: Read a Vietnamese sentence, write it in English and get it corrected on the spot: what is wrong, why, and how a native speaker would say it.
Hero.note: Sign in with Google or email and start practising right away.

Demo.comment: Almost there! Watch your past simple.

HowItWorks.title: Three steps for every sentence
HowItWorks.step1Title: Pick a level and a topic
HowItWorks.step1Body: From short, familiar sentences to complex ones, across 20 topics from daily life to work.
HowItWorks.step2Body: Write your English version. Open the key-word hint if you need it, press Enter to send.
HowItWorks.step3Body: If it is wrong you see where and why. If it is right you earn 10 points and move on.

Features.title: Made for learning, not just marking
Features.reasonsBody: Every mistake comes with a reason in your language, not only the right answer.
Features.naturalBody: Correct but stiff? See how native speakers say the same thing.
Features.structureBody: Accepted answers come with a structure note you can reuse in other sentences.
Features.progressBody: A progress bar on every topic shows exactly how far you have got.
Features.pointsBody: 10 points for the first time you get a sentence right, and fireworks when you finish a topic.
Features.historyBody: Your correct answers are saved so you can look back at them whenever you like.

Faq.title: Questions, answered
Faq.q1: Do I need to sign in?
Faq.a1: Yes. You sign in with Google or email so your progress, points and correct answers are saved to you.
Faq.a2: When the AI marks an answer wrong it costs 1 credit. Right answers are free, and so is checking against the accepted answers.
Faq.q3: What happens when my credits run out?
Faq.a3: You can keep practising by switching to Accepted answers. A sentence that matches a saved answer is also marked right for free.
Faq.a4: Only your correct answers are saved, so you can review them, and only you can see them. Wrong answers are not kept.
Faq.q5: Is the site available in English?
Faq.a5: Yes. Switch between Vietnamese and English at the top, and the feedback follows the language you choose.
